scale.label: Easy
scale.technical: Paved, boardwalk or wide flat path; no exposure

scale.label: Moderate
scale.technical: Well-marked path, some steep sections, no hands

scale.label: Challenging
scale.technical: Steep, rough or loose; sure-footedness needed

scale.label: Hard
scale.technical: Long steep sections, rough terrain, possible short hands-on steps, some exposure

systems.label: SAC (OSM sac_scale)
systems.note: Hiking (T1) maps to grade 2; a short T1 stroll maps to grade 1.

systems.label: Parks Canada

mappings.note: Upper end can read as grade 2
Upper end can read as grade 3
Lower end can read as grade 3

systems.note: Plan 3A table: house 2 is Easy (upper) to Moderate, house 3 is Moderate (upper) to Difficult.

systems.label: Sepaq and Quebec resorts
systems.note: Grade 5 does not exist in this system.

systems.label: Norwegian Trekking Association (DNT)
systems.note: Green, blue, red and black are not mapped yet; add them when a Norway trail is researched.

systems.label: Other or unknown system
systems.note: Without a mapping the house grade equals the effort grade and house_basis is effort-only.

effort.note: Grade 5 is reserved for technical terrain. Bands are the half-open ranges [0,6), [6,12), [12,20), [20,30) and 30 or more.

rule.house_grade: house_grade = max(technical grade from the local system, effort grade)
rule.no_local_grade: When the local grade is missing, technical is null, house_grade equals the effort grade and house_basis is effort-only (shown as a hollow badge).
